cmdPalette.title: Command palette
cmdPalette.description: Search and jump to any page or action
cmdPalette.searchPlaceholder: Type a command or search VMs, jobs…
cmdPalette.startedDescription: Watch it progress live in Activity.
cmdPalette.alreadyRunningDescription: Let the current run finish first.
cmdPalette.jobDisabledDescription: Enable the job to run it.
cmdPalette.runRefusedDescription: The appliance didn’t start the run and gave no reason. Try again from the job’s page.

topbar.twoFactorOff: Two-factor sign-in is off. Turn it on in Settings → Security.
topbar.signOutToast: This is a front-end prototype — no real session to sign out of.
topbar.demoDataTip: Showing the built-in demo world. ⌘K → “Connect to live appliance” to switch.
topbar.reconnectingTip: Lost the appliance event stream — reconnecting.

body.success: The run finished with no errors.
body.warning: The run finished, but the appliance reported warnings.
body.failed: The appliance reported the run as failed.

apiVersionBanner.title: Incompatible API version
apiVersionBanner.fallback: The console and appliance API versions are incompatible. Reload after the deployment finishes, or contact your administrator.

offline.title: Lost contact with the appliance.
offline.body: Nothing on this page is updating — runs, capacity and alerts are whatever they were when the connection dropped. Reconnecting in the background.

clockJump.title: Retention is paused: the server clock jumped forward.
clockJump.body: Restore points would look older than they are, so retention deletes nothing until an Administrator confirms the server time.

dialog.title: Confirm the server time
dialog.lead: Retention measures the age of every restore point from this clock. Confirm only if the server time below is correct: restore points removed on a wrong clock cannot be brought back.
dialog.done: Server time confirmed; retention removes expired restore points again.
dialog.failed: Could not confirm the server time

idle.title: Still there?
idle.body: The console signs out after {{duration}} without a click, key press or scroll. Stay signed in to keep working.
idle.bodyNoDuration: The console signs out after a stretch without a click, key press or scroll. Stay signed in to keep working.

limit.title: Your session ends in {{countdown}}
limit.body: Every session ends a fixed time after sign-in, active or not: this one at {{time}}. Save what you are working on, then sign in again.
